rules.name: rrr-orm-qcx-probe
rules.sql: SELECT t.trade_id, t.contract_number, t.counterparty_parent, t.subportfolio, t.deal_status, t.netting_status, t.transaction_date, t.market_action, t.original_lots, l.active_lots AS latest_active_lots, t.security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t LEFT JOIN opera.latest_active_lot l ON l.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND l.business_unit = t.business_unit AND l.trade_id = t.trade_id WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(t.contract_number, '_', 1)) = 'QCX' ORDER BY t.contract_number LIMIT 100

SELECT p.trade_id, p.contract_number, p.client_code, p.counterparty_parent, p.derivative_type, p.active_lots, p.mtm_usd, p.mkt_value_usd FROM opera.fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2( (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), CAST(:bu AS text), CAST(:valueDate AS date), (SELECT jsonb_agg(m.client_code) FROM opera.client_master_data m WHERE m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND m.business_unit = :bu)) p WHERE upper(split_part(p.contract_number, '_', 1)) = 'QCX' OR upper(trim(p.client_code)) = 'QCX' ORDER BY p.contract_number LIMIT 100

SELECT upper(trim(p.client_code)) AS client_column, upper(split_part(p.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS contract_prefix, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, ROUND(SUM(p.mtm_usd)::numeric, 2) AS sum_mtm_usd FROM opera.fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2( (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), CAST(:bu AS text), CAST(:valueDate AS date), (SELECT jsonb_agg(m.client_code) FROM opera.client_master_data m WHERE m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND m.business_unit = :bu)) p GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 100
